meta.title: Design closure
meta.description: Adds a design-closure agent preset: the design side is taken to the end, the verification side only gets a handoff. Covers architecture and budgets, eight-chapter design specs written forward or reverse-engineered from RTL, with mandatory closure self-checks, functional-point and acceptance observation point lists, RTL, lint/CDC, synthesis and timing closure, PPA and SoC integration, stopping at the VP list.
